Game Overview

Bank Breaker: Collecting Coins is a hyper-casual title where dodge vaults, seize shimmering coins, and outrun the clock in a high-stakes neon caper. As a stylish thief, rob banks in a mesmerizing arcade experience with smooth controls and captivating visuals. Perfect for quick sessions, test your skills and see how many coins you can snatch before time expires.
